Berserk rage has the following effects.
• Reduce all incoming damage (supernatural or otherwise) by 50%
• Double your resistance levels (ie 7 -> 14, 8 -> 16).
• In this frenzy the Berserker is unable to differentiate friend from foe, and will attack any who look hostile.
• Berserkers cannot use any non-weapon blow active skill whilst Berserking.
• Berserkers have no choice about the use of this ability and must engage whenever they are faced with any hostile situation
